_notes: Copy to config.json and replace every REPLACE-ME with an exact OpenRouter model id (python run_pilot.py --suggest-models).
seats: one mid-class model per lab for the mid tier. hub: a frontier-class model (the paper requires the hub to match the top tier in play).
baseline: the best single frontier model, used for conditions a and b. Using the same model as the hub is fine and makes c-vs-a a test of the process, not of a stronger model.
Pinned ids are recorded in results/run_meta.json as the version stamps for the catalogue.
answer_tokens caps calls that write an answer (a ceiling, not a spend); max_k caps condition b's samples per task; max_k_dollars caps the dollar-matched condition bd.
baseline_alt is a frontier model from a second lab for condition a3 (one pass), a check on whether refusals are lab-specific.
provider_pins keeps a lab's model on the lab's own endpoint; fallback hosts returned empty, filtered replies in pilot 1.
